usage.callShape: POST https://sol.blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with JSON body {model, messages:[{role,content}], max_tokens} (OpenAI chat-completions shape)
usage.outputShape: body.choices[0].message.content (assistant text); finish_reason at body.choices[0].finish_reason; token usage at body.usage.prompt_tokens / body.usage.completion_tokens / body.usage.total_tokens; resolved model at body.model
quirks: This is the OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint: response text is at body.choices[0].message.content (NOT body.content[0].text — that is the sibling Anthropic /api/v1/messages endpoint).
'model' must be a router enum ID from the BlockRun catalog, e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5, openai/gpt-5.4-mini, google/gemini-3.5-flash. A bare model name will not resolve.
Pricing is token-based/dynamic; $0.001 is the floor. Keep prompts short and max_tokens small to control cost.
Payment is x402 USDC on SOLANA (not Base) — asset USDC EPjFWdd...Dt1v, payTo AQqnMFB...EeKA, fee-payer sponsored. No API key/account.
Must be POST; GET returns 402 only as the payment probe and will not complete a chat.
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://sol.blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with an OpenAI chat-completions JSON body: {"model":"anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}],"max_tokens":16}. The model must be a BlockRun router enum ID (e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5, openai/gpt-5.4-mini). Pay via x402 USDC on Solana; no API key or account needed. Read the assistant reply at body.choices[0].message.content and token usage at body.usage. Cost is dynamic/token-based (floor ~$0.001), so keep prompts short and max_tokens small.
